KAG AngelScript API

Welcome to the King Arthur’s Gold AngelScript API docs!
Here you can browse through all functions, objects, hooks, and globals used in the game. Where possible, code examples from the scripts in Base are given. There are also some community-authored modding guides for certain useful concepts such as TCPR.
The contents of these docs are based on the KAG 'Manual' directory, which is generated automatically by the game to document the available AngelScript interface.
